schema: Audio-V published origin calibration blocker report v1
conclusion: Threshold search alone is not justified because the dominant blockers are missing cutoff, cliff, and regional-stability measurements. Add and validate another standalone spectral evidence family before selecting candidate Oracle thresholds.
limitations: Counts are descriptive over correlated derivative cases; the independent unit is the 18 development source groups.
Calibration and held-out test groups were not opened for this diagnostic.
A blocker is diagnostic evidence and is not permission to relax a production rule.
